beats.outfit: Kaydoudou in grey tracksuit trousers and his sun-yellow T-shirt with the red stripe on the left of the chest, red sock on his RIGHT foot and yellow sock on his LEFT foot, small soft afro. BriBri in a plain green T-shirt and dark trousers, shaved part on the left, the braided blue and white bracelet on his LEFT wrist.
beats.action: In the middle of the bedroom rug, Kaydoudou imitates Kenzo: both hands lifted to his head as if twirling imaginary curls, chin high, eyelids half closed with a snooty look, shoulders rolling as he struts. On the edge of his bed, BriBri sits hunched with his elbows on his knees, not laughing yet, the corner of his mouth just starting to twitch.
beats.location: The brothers' small bedroom in a third-floor flat in Bussy-Saint-Georges, two beds, a football poster with no writing, a window onto the night and the lit train station below.
beats.light: Warm yellow bedside lamp light in the evening, deep blue night in the window.
beats.camera: Medium shot from the doorway, Kaydoudou strutting in the foreground on the left, BriBri on the bed on the right.
beats.alt: Dans leur chambre, Kaydoudou imite Kenzo en se faisant des boucles imaginaires, et BriBri retient un sourire sur son lit.

beats.anchor: Lacombe prend BriBri par les épaules
beats.extras: Monsieur Bertrand Lacombe, 55, pale skin, short grey hair, a thick grey moustache trimmed like a shoe brush, navy tracksuit, a metal whistle on a lace, both dry hands on BriBri's shoulders. Mathis, 13, a tall U14 defender with pale skin and short dark hair, in a grey ESM training top, standing behind BriBri with his hands on his hips. Two orange training cones on the turf.
beats.outfit: BriBri in his old faded green shirt with the white collar and white number 8, black shorts, white socks, worn black boots, shaved part on the left, the braided blue and white bracelet on his LEFT wrist.
beats.action: Lacombe holds BriBri by both shoulders and turns him a quarter turn sideways, like opening a door. BriBri's face changes as his eyes suddenly take in the whole pitch: the passer in front of him and the open field beyond. Behind him, Mathis watches with a little smirk. A ball rests at BriBri's left foot.
beats.location: The edge of an artificial training pitch at the ESM centre on an October evening.
beats.light: White floodlights at night making the fine rain sparkle like silver dust, cold blue air, warm skin tones.
beats.camera: Medium shot from the side at chest height, the quarter turn readable in the bodies, the bright empty pitch opening on the right.
beats.alt: Sous les projecteurs, Monsieur Lacombe fait pivoter BriBri d'un quart de tour pour lui ouvrir le corps vers le jeu.

beats.anchor: Pfiou ! La passe traverse deux lignes d'un coup.
beats.extras: Kenzo Delattre, 13, brown curls, very white boots, white ESM kit with number 8 on the back, sprinting behind the opposing midfield. Racing Club des Coteaux players, about 13, mixed skin tones, in orange shirts, caught flat-footed in two lines, turning their heads too late.
beats.outfit: BriBri in the white ESM shirt with the star on the heart, seen from the front so no number shows, shaved part on the left, the braided blue and white bracelet on his LEFT wrist. Kaydoudou far ahead in the white ESM shirt with number 7, red sock on his RIGHT foot and yellow sock on his LEFT foot, starting his run toward the far post.
beats.action: BriBri, body open sideways, has just struck the ball with his left foot in one touch; his calm eyes follow it. The ball slices low through a gap between two lines of orange shirts toward Kenzo's run. Far ahead, Kaydoudou is already on his toes, ready to sprint to the far post.
beats.location: A suburban artificial pitch on a grey Saturday, a white rail around it, parents blurred behind, Papa's green, red and yellow scarf a small bright spot in the crowd.
beats.light: Soft grey daylight on a damp pitch, the white kits glowing, sharp motion on the ball.
beats.camera: Dynamic low angle behind and beside BriBri, the line of the pass running diagonally into the depth of the frame, the two orange lines split by it.
beats.alt: Le corps ouvert, BriBri envoie une passe qui traverse deux lignes d'un coup vers la course de Kenzo.
